Commentary.Commentary: So that ends the proceedings of this match. An unfortunate result in the end with the weather having the last say. This group has opened up nicely now. Tomorrow, we move across the border as we travel to Wales to catch the hosts England in action against New Zealand. The match will take place at Sophia Gardens, Cardiff at 1030 local time (0930 GMT). Hope that you all tune in for that game. Till then, take care! Cheers!

Mashrafe Mortaza says Australia are unlucky but his side is lucky to stay alive in the tournament, even if it isn't in the fashion they would have liked. Wants his team to play hard again next match as anything can happen. Agrees with Steven Smith that his batters got challenged by the Australian bowlers. Ends by crediting Tamim Iqbal for batting the way he did but is disappointed nobody else could support him enough.

Steven Smith says it's disappointing to not get a game in today. Adds they had a good half so is disappointed not to get anything today. Mentions their next game against England is virtually a knockout for them and it will be tough so anything could happen. (On his bowlers) Feels they were much better today as they hit the right areas early on and challenged the Bangladeshi batters. (On him and Warner getting time to bat) States time in the middle is always valuable and reiterates you can't do much about the weather so just have to move on. When asked about why he brought Adam Zampa on to bowl so late, he says there were two left-hand batters in for quite a while and a breeze blowing from one end so as soon as one of them got out, he brought him in.

Bangladesh, on the other hand, won't mind the result as Australia were firmly in the driver's seat. Today, they didn't have a terrific time apart from Tamim Iqbal, who had another fine outing with the bat. With this, Bangladesh open their account in the points table while Australia share points for the second time in the tournament. They'll feel hard done, given that they were just 4 overs away from clinching a possible victory.

The other day, Australia would have been happy with the result while today, they would be furious with it. They were superb with the ball and bowled Bangladesh out for a paltry total of 182, Mitchell Starc being the tormentor-in-chief with 4 wickets. They then came out to bat and looked at ease. Aaron Finch fell early but David Warner was going along nicely and was supported well by Steven Smith till the rain decided to play spoilsport.
UPDATE 2115 LOCAL TIME - Bad news, folks! The verdict is out and the MATCH HAS BEEN ABANDONED! The points will be shared.

UPDATE 2015 LOCAL TIME - Don't want to be the party pooper here but the rain is back and the covers are brought on again. It's just a little drizzle for the moment, hopefully it passes away quickly. The wait continues...
UPDATE 2007 LOCAL TIME - The rain has completely stopped now and the covers are off. The umpire are done inspecting and the news from the middle is that the PLAY WILL RESUME AT 2030 LOCAL TIME.

UPDATE 1930 LOCAL TIME - The news from the middle is slightly better as the rain has stopped as of now but as plenty of rain had already poured down, the outfield is still wet and the groundsmen are working hard to dry it. However, it's much brighter out there than earlier and slowly the covers are coming off. 2159 LOCAL TIME is the cut-off time for a 20-over game. There will be a next update at 2000 local time. So stay tuned!
UPDATE 1900 LOCAL TIME - The rain is still pouring at The Oval and it looks like we are in for a big delay. We will have the next update at 1930 local time. Stay tuned for further updates.

As feared, the rain has really picked up and has forced the umpires' hands. They have asked the players to walk off the field and return to their respective dressing rooms. We are going to have a halt in play due to that. Need to get 4 more overs in to get a result from this game. 49/1 is what's required of Australia at the end of 20 overs and clearly they're well ahead. They will hope somehow the ground is ready enough for them to get over the line.
Full ball from Mashrafe Mortaza, Steven Smith comfortably meets it with a straight blade.
The rain is getting heavier and heavier. All eyes on the umpires now to see what call they make. Drinks are 'round the corner.
Fractionally ahead of a length, just outside off, tapped away a little square in front of cover-point.
On the shorter side of the length, kept out off the back foot.
Hurls a fuller length ball on the fourth stump line, the Aussie captain walks across to get behind the line and block.
Slower in pace on the stumps, Smith pushes it back down the track.
Fuller in length and just around off, David Warner comes forward and off the inner half, pushes it towards mid on for a quick run.
It has started to drizzle and it's getting heavier as I type this. Australia will hope that it goes away while Bangladesh will hope other way round.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. One run added to the total.
Stays within his crease and blocks it out.
Full and coming back in, catches Warner low on the pads as he looks to flick. Was probably going down leg so no appeal from the fielding side.

Excellent length delivery around off, angling in first then straightening up just a shade, Warner looks to defend from within his crease but the ball just cuts him through. Goes past the inside edge and into the keeper's glove. Superb delivery.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, with some width on offer, Steven crunches it square straight to the point fielder.
Cutter on middle and leg, on a length, Steven Smith walks across like he usually does and with soft hands, clips it down to fine leg for one run.
On middle and leg, turned to square leg for an easy run.
4000 ODI runs for David Warner! Quickest Australian to reach this feat.
Full on the pads, clipped past short fine leg for a double.
Takes some pace off this and pitches it around off, Warner plants his front foot forward and blocks.
Fullish in length around off, pushed back down the ground for a brisk single.
Full ball bowled outside off, Smith walks across and whips it to wide mid on.
Just back of a length, it's not short enough for Warner to pull. He still goes through with the shot and ends up mistiming it towards wide mid on.
Short of a good length, well outside off, punched a bit square on the off side for one run.
Short ball and it's pulled away by Steven Smith along the ground through square leg. This time the Australian skipper gets a couple of runs.
Length delivery on the hips, glanced through backward square leg for just a single this time.
Outside off on a good length, Warner punches it to point on the bump. A misfield there enables him to take two runs. Third man took a bit of time to come across and cut it off.
Quite straight in line, allows the southpaw to tuck it to fine leg. Runs the first one hard and as a result is able to come back for the second. Good running between the wickets.
Rubel Hossain to have a change of ends.
Another cutter from Bangladeshi skipper. Rolls his fingers over it and pitches it on off, Warner just waits for it and guides it down to third man with an open face. Single taken.
Comfortably done. Steven Smith leans across to this length delivery and clips it down to fine leg to get off strike.
Back of a length delivery angling across, David stands tall and slaps it through extra cover for a quick one.
Off cutter moving away from around off, whiskers past the outside edge of David Warner's bat who attempts to defend.
Full from Mortaza, driven back down the ground for an easy run.

Good length delivery on off, Smith hangs his bat out to block but is undone a bit by the extra bounce. The ball takes the inside edge and races away to fine leg, where the fielder runs to his right to make a good diving stop. Two runs are taken.
Mashrafe Mortaza back on.
Full and flat wide outside off, David Warner with a hard drive straight to extra cover.
Around the wicket again to the left-hander, it's looped up on middle and off, blocked off the front foot.
Darted on the pads from over the wicket, worked away through square leg for another run.
Back to over the wicket, it's landed on a length, Warner backs away and punches it towards sweeper cover for one more.
Over the wicket now, flat and short outside off, Smith rocks back and punches it down to long on for a single.
Floats it up outside off from around the wicket, not much turn on it as David Warner drives it through to sweeper cover for a single.
Mehedi Hasan is into the attack now. A slip is in place for him!
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. Now, 4 players can be placed outside the inner ring till the 40th over.
Slight behind length around leg, tucked on the leg side for a single.
Full and wide outside off, Warner looks to punish it through the off side but misses it completely.
On a length and angling away, Warner looks to pull it but it's not short enough to be pulled.
Length delivery, angling away, punched to the off side.
Length delivery, angling in, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
Full outside off, Warner pushes it gently in the mid off region for a single.
Full outside off, Smith shimmies across and pushes it to cover-point.
Fuller in the line of the stumps, flicked to mid-wicket.
Full toss outside off, Smith mistimes his punch down the ground on the off side for a couple.
Catching point comes in place.
FOUR! Full outside off, Smith drives it uppishly through covers. Strangely neither there's a catching fielder nor there's a sweeper cover in place and the ball finds the fence.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
What a delivery! A yorker on leg, Smith digs it out square of the wicket on the leg side.
Mustafizur Rahman will continue. A wicket is down, perfect time for him to make further inroads.

Good, confident start! A touch fuller in the line of the stumps, Smith shimmies across and flicks it from the middle through square leg. The players from the infield chases it down and saves a run for his team.
Steven Smith strides out at No.3!

OUT! Plumb! Pitches on the fuller side of the length around off, skids through after pitching. Also tails in a touch. Finch is undone by the inward movement as he is late in bringing his bat down in time. Gets rapped on the back pad and the umpire rules it out immediately on the appeal. Rubel Hossain draws first blood. They need wickets in a flurry now.
FOUR! Pulled handsomely! Short and angling in, Finch pulls it over backward square leg for a boundary. That will boost his confidence.
Cutter outside off, Finch stands tall and defends it down the wicket.
Slightly back of a length, Warner gets on his toes and tucks it wide of mid on for a single.
Full outside off, Warner drives it on the bounce to cover-point, who dives to his right to make a good stop.
Rubel Hossain comes into the attack.
Full around off, Finch covers the stumps and defends it to covers.
Fuller length delivery, angling in, Warner with gentle hands clips to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Angling away from Finch, he pushes it through covers for a single.
Another cutter from the Fizz. Finch looks to heave it on the leg side but gets it off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Cutter from Mustafizur, angling away, Finch looks to push it with the angle but gets beaten by the variation.
Pitched a touch ahead of length, angling in, Warner presses ahead and flicks it off the inner half on the leg side for a single.
On a length outside off, Finch stays in his crease and defends it in covers.
Wide! Slower one, angling down leg. Finch covers his stumps, looks to tickle it but misses. A wide is signalled.
Straying on the pads, flicked on the leg side for a single.
Outside off, run down to third man for a single.
Slower one, angling away, Warner pushes it to mid off and takes another quick single.
FOUR! Pulled into the gap! Slower delivery on the shorter side, Warner pulls it with ease over backward square leg for a boundary.
Angling into Finch, he defends it to mid on and takes a quick single.
Another cutter from Rahman outside off, Warner taps it through point. There's a misfield there and a brace is taken.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Warner looks to glide it on the off side but misses.
Full outside off, Warner taps it on the off side and takes off for a single but is sent back.

FOUR! Streaky! Back of a length delivery outside off, Warner looks to pull it through but gets an inside edge past the keeper. It runs too fine and the man at fine leg fails to cut it off. Boundary for Warner.
Fizz bowls a cutter, Finch punches it to mid on and takes off for a quick single. There's a direct hit at the non-striker's end but Finch is safely in.
Beaten! Angling away from Finch. Zips through after pitching and it's too good for the Aussie opener, who gets beaten as he looks to defend.
Another slower one, angling in, Finch looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls on the off side and Warner calls Finch for a quick single. Superb running, this.
Another slower one, angling in, Aaron leans ahead and flicks it through square leg. They pick up a couple. Good running.
Finch defends the length delivery down the wicket but on the off side this time.
Slower delivery, angling in, defended down the wicket on the leg side.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Full down the leg side, Finch tickles it very fine. Beats short fine leg and the ball races to the fence. That was a poor, poor delivery given fine leg was up inside the circle.
A touch back of a length around leg, tucked through square leg for a single.
Length delivery in the line of the stumps, pushed to covers.
Mustafizur rolls his fingers around the ball, gets it to angle across. Finch goes for a big shot but misses it completely.
Angling across Finch, he hops and punches it to short cover.
FOUR! Good way to get off the mark! Pitched on a length, angling away, Finch punches it through point. Places it superbly and the ball races to the fence.
Length delivery, angling away, left alone.
Leg bye! Full and tailing into the southpaw, Warner fails to flick it and the ball rolls off the pads on the leg side. A leg bye is taken. There was a muted appeal for lbw but it was turned down.
Angling into Finch, punched off the back foot to mid-wicket.
Pitched on a length outside off, Finch looks to play on the off side but gets it off the outer half to point.
Peach of a delivery! On a good length outside off, shaping away just a touch. Finch looks to push it on the off side but gets beaten. That was a fine delivery.
Pitched outside off, Finch defends it with a straight bat.
Length delivery, angling in, defended on the leg side. The mid-wicket fielder, gets to his left and cuts it off.
Length delivery around leg, Warner flicks it on the leg side and takes off for a single. Kayes at mid-wicket fumbles and allows the single to be taken comfortably.
Mashrafe Mortaza to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Back of a length outside off, punched through cover-point. Times it beautifully but the outfield is sluggish and the ball slows down. Three runs taken.

Four running runs! A touch ahead of length on middle and leg, angling in, Warner flicks it nicely through mid-wicket. The outfield is slow and so the ball doesn't race to the fence. Kayes chases down the ball and drags it in just before the fence but by that time, the batsmen pick up four.
Fuller length delivery, angling in, David leans ahead and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length outside off, Warner shimmies across a touch and tucks it straight to square leg.
This time Warner gets behind the line and defends it from the middle of the bat.
Beaten! Good start this for Bangladesh. Bowls it on a good length outside off and straightens a touch. Warner plays inside the line and gets beaten.

The Bangladeshi fielders have taken the field. Aaron Finch and David Warner to open for Australia. The target is not much of a concern for them but the weather is that heavier rain is predicted later on. Let's hope we don't have any delays. Mustafizur Rahman to take the first new ball. He has one slip in place. Here we go..
